name: FAQ category (empty collection)

emptyState.note: LOCKED TRUE. Both CMS collections on /faq are genuinely empty on the original: the server HTML ships no item template at all, only Webflow's .w-dyn-empty placeholder. So /faq genuinely has NO FAQ content and NO accordion is rendered on it.

constraints.noInventedContent: A generated instance must not invent FAQ copy. There is no items field.
constraints.noConsecutiveException: This section legitimately appears TWICE in a row on /faq ('For parents' then 'For sitters'). compatibility/graph.json lists it as a named exception to NO_ADJACENT_SAME_CATEGORY.

motion.note: No entrance or scroll animation. Global .btn hover transitions only.

responsive.desktop: .row.row-justify-around with a col-lg-4 heading column and a col-lg-7 list column. Sections 278.4px tall.
responsive.le991: columns narrow; the 'For parents' heading wraps to two lines at 1024, growing the first section to 334.4px.
responsive.le479: both columns go flex-basis 100%; sections 257.4px tall.

notes: The accordion CSS exists in the design system (and is used by /careers' job rows) but has ZERO live instances on /faq.
